keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: 'Sybaris was also a dominant power in the region and ruled over 4 tribes and 25 cities.' The page does not date the dominion; the nearest dated expansion is the conquest of Siris 'in the middle of the sixth century BC' in alliance with Metapontum and Kroton. The province of Cosenza (5,817 km2) is a reading of the dominion (Laus and Scidrus were Sybarite colonies on the Tyrrhenian side).

ledger.note: 720: Achaeans and Troezenians found Sybaris. 'The city was founded around 720 BC by Achaean and Troezenian settlers'; 'founded in 720 BC by Is [sic] of Helice' (Strabo is the only source). Magna Graecia gives '721-720 (or 709-708) BC'. The land (a 30 km disc) is the researcher's reading.

region.text: the dominion of Sybaris: '4 tribes and 25 cities', read as northern Calabria (province of Cosenza)

ledger.note: The dominion of 25 cities. 'Sybaris ... ruled over 4 tribes and 25 cities'; the page does not date it. Bridging year: the alliance with Metapontum and Kroton 'resulted in the conquest of Siris in the middle of the sixth century BC'. The extent is the province of Cosenza as a reading; Poseidonia (founded c. 600) was a colony, not drawn.

ledger.note: 510: Kroton destroys Sybaris. 'The city of Sybaris was destroyed in about 510 BC by its neighbour Kroton' (Diodorus: the oligarchy overthrown '510/509'); 'Croton sent an army of 100,000 men commanded by the wrestler Milo' (Crotone page). The page says Sybaris survived as 'a dependent ally' of Kroton.

ledger.note: 510: the end of Sybaris. Survivors 'took refuge at their colonies Laus and Scidrus'; Strabo's diversion of the Crathis to drown the city is disputed on the page ('natural alluviation').

wars.outcome: Kroton destroyed Sybaris about 510 BC and became head of a confederation of the 25 city-states of its region.
wars.note: The Crotone page does not date the destruction precisely (it dates the crisis to 510); the Magna Graecia page says Sybaris 'may have' been destroyed around 510. Earlier war: the conquest of Siris in the middle of the sixth century BC by Sybaris, Metapontum and Kroton against the Ionian colony Siris.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier of Sybaris; the dominion is 'tribes and cities', not a bounded territory.

notes: Sybaris is drawn as a city territory (30 km disc round Sibari) until the dominion of 25 cities, then as the province of Cosenza, both researcher's readings; neither page gives a km2 or a boundary. The dominion's date is a bridge (-550, confidence 1). The page's two accounts conflict: destroyed by Kroton in about 510 (and the river diverted) against 'not completely destroyed ... a dependent ally of Kroton'; the dossier ends in 510 and Croton takes the region. The refoundation of 452/451, the expulsion of 446/445, 'Sybaris on the Traeis' (shortly after 444) and Thurii (444/43, 'under Athenian leadership', destroyed 193) are outside the life and need their own entry (Thurii is a Panhellenic colony of Athens: a candidate dossier). Gazetteer names needed: Sibari (place). Type 'colony' follows the schema's list (Greek colonies of Magna Graecia).
